uutiset.t: US Large-Cap Stocks Upgraded to Most Favorable at Wells Fargo
uutiset.s: Wells Fargo Investment Institute analysts upgraded US large-cap stocks to its highest rating, after last week’s rout offered investors the opportunity to add equity exposure at more attractive levels.

uutiset.t: Permian Gas Flaring Plunges as New Pipelines Enter Service
uutiset.s: Flaring of natural gas in the Permian Basin has fallen to the lowest level in three years as new pipelines relieve a bottleneck that pushed prices into deeply negative territory earlier this year.

uutiset.t: Jeff Currie Sees a Liquidity Crisis Behind Copper Selloff
uutiset.s: Jeff Currie, CEO at Real Macro, examines the copper selloff and explains what would make him return to being long gold and copper. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Goldman’s Trivedi Says Dollar ‘Has Some Fight’ Left on Rate Path
uutiset.s: The US dollar rally has legs with rising interest rates spurring the currency further before it weakens “modestly” next year, according to Kamakshya Trivedi at Goldman Sachs Group Inc.

uutiset.t: Nvidia’s Comeback Exposes the Trap Gripping Stock Investors
uutiset.s: Monday’s spectacular stock rebound exposes the latest trap facing investors in a market dominated by a handful of technology giants: Selling them offers protection when markets plunge, but risks missing the recovery.

uutiset.t: Germany to Press Ahead With Gasoline Price Cap From Next Year
uutiset.s: Germany is set to move ahead with a temporary three-month cap on gasoline prices from the start of next year as Berlin attempts to shield drivers in Europe’s biggest economy from higher fuel costs caused by the Iran war.

uutiset.t: Asian Stocks Drop As AI Worries Offset State Support Measures
uutiset.s: South Korean and Chinese shares fell, showing investor sentiment toward the AI trade remains fragile even after Asian authorities rolled out support measures and US markets showed signs of stabilizing. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Port Authority Eyes $1 Billion Muni Sale as Cost Pressures Mount
uutiset.s: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey is planning to issue more than $1 billion of municipal bonds as rising construction costs add pressure to its $45 billion capital program.

uutiset.t: Nvidia Rehires Huang in Stunning Comeback
uutiset.s: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as head of the world’s largest chipmaker in one of the most startling corporate comebacks in history, sending the stock on its biggest rally in decades. Ed Ludlow explains how we got here (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: UBS Debate Turns to Amendments on $16 Billion Capital Bill
uutiset.s: At least four competing proposals are on the table when Swiss lawmakers convene to discuss UBS Group AG’s capital requirements on Tuesday, with little sign yet of the path to consensus.

uutiset.t: Nigeria’s Naira Weakens With Investors Wary of Election Upset
uutiset.s: Nigeria’s naira is seeing increasing volatility as uncertainty over next year’s election and expectations of higher US interest rates see investors shift away from the West African nation.

uutiset.t: Braskem, Creditors Reach Deal on Out-of-Court Debt Revamp
uutiset.s: Braskem SA and its creditors have reached an agreement on the main terms of an out-of-court restructuring deal, a key step in the Brazilian petrochemical giant’s efforts to rework its debt after months of tense negotiations.

uutiset.t: Credit Heads ‘Swivel’ as Huang Return Ignites Tech Debt Rally
uutiset.s: Corporate-debt markets rallied globally on Monday, with US fear gauges improving the most in months and technology firms’ bonds rebounding after Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive officer.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Fluctuate as AI Sector Rallies on Nvidia CEO Return
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares turned positive Monday, bringing the artificial intelligence lab in line with the rest of the sector’s rebound following the reinstatement of Nvidia Corp.’s Jensen Huang.

uutiset.t: Stellantis Quits Auto Racing as CEO Ramps Up Cost Cuts
uutiset.s: Stellantis NV is withdrawing from auto racing in Europe, as the car manufacturer pushes ahead with cost cuts and a turnaround plan that’s struggling to win over investors.
